faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the KCMMF Sales Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application for the KCMMF Sales Officer recruitment is 4th September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sales Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA in Marketing, a Postgraduate degree in Agri-Business Management, or a Postgraduate degree in Food Science and Technology to be eligible for the Sales Officer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Sales Officer role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Sales Officer position is 40 years. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sales Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Sales Officer post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 47,000 per month, which includes consolidated pay, travel allowance, and incentives.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Sales Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Sales Officer post announced by the Kerala Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation (KCMMF) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the KCMMF Sales Officer recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Sales Officer post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Sales Officer post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Sales Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves multiple stages including Application Screening, Criteria-based Screening, Written Test, Group Discussion, Skill Test, Proficiency Test, and finally, an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does KCMMF offer contract-based jobs?
faq.answer: Yes, the Sales Officer position in this KCMMF recruitment is on a contract basis, offering a good opportunity for individuals seeking short-term engagement with a government organization.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
